correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly checks quantifiers n≥4, R,h>0; determinant multiaffinity reduces all tetrahedra to prism vertices and gives a full equality criterion. Crossing chords strictly dominate noncrossing and triangular configurations. Strict Schur concavity of the three sine factors gives the balanced gap form, which yields counts. Binary gap transfers bound and construct exact optimizer-family dimensions. The bundled checker verifies 398733 finite tetrahedron determinants, chord spectra for n≤48 and face dimensions n≤17; finite checks supplement but cannot replace proof.

value.rationale: The complete equality locus for a natural infinite family is the motivated invariant beyond the previously published scalar bound. It provides explicit optimizer counts and exhibits a geometric degeneracy jump between isolated maximizers, one-dimensional families and two-dimensional families governed by n modulo four. Natural exact classifications qualify independently of claims to general algorithms or universal theorems.
